author: Unknown
title: MAF-DAD: Reasonable grounds to suspect war crimes in North and East Syria
content:
The Association for Democracy and International Law (MAF-DAD) has published its report, International Crimes Committed by and on Behalf of the Government of the Syrian Arab Republic, examining developments in North and East Syria in January and February 2026.


MAF-DAD’s independent Fact-Finding Mission investigated violations in North and East Syria following attacks on the Sheikh Maqsoud (Şêxmeqsûd) and Ashrafiah (Eşrefiyê) neighbourhoods of Aleppo in early January 2026. Members of the mission conducted field investigations in the region between 21 February and 17 March 2026.


The report said 32 detailed qualitative interviews were conducted as part of the fieldwork, involving a total of 62 people. Those interviewed included 25 direct victims, one victim’s family and six representatives of institutions and organisations involved in documenting violations or assisting victims.


MAF-DAD said the report was based on a comparative assessment of statements from victims and witnesses, direct field observations, medical records, reports by institutions and civil society organisations, evidence collected by the Rojava Information Center (RIC) and open-source material. The report applied the standard of “reasonable grounds to believe” that a violation had occurred.


Attacks on civilians


The report said attacks on civilians in January 2026 were concentrated particularly in the Sheikh Maqsoud and Ashrafiah neighbourhoods of Aleppo and along routes leading out of Tabqa and Raqqa (Reqa).


The field investigation documented drone strikes, artillery fire, sniper attacks, gunfire directed at vehicles, violence at checkpoints, attacks on areas where civilians had sought shelter and direct attacks on homes.


The report also included testimony that civilians attempting to flee Tabqa and Raqqa came under fire, were stopped, searched, robbed and detained, and in some cases killed.


MAF-DAD concluded that the evidence provided reasonable grounds to believe that civilians had been deliberately and indiscriminately targeted and that these acts constituted serious violations of international humanitarian law and war crimes.


Hospitals and healthcare workers targeted


The report examined attacks on healthcare infrastructure in Sheikh Maqsoud and Ashrafiah in a separate section.


MAF-DAD said Xalid Fecir Hospital and Osman Hospital were targeted by artillery fire. Evidence was also collected indicating that healthcare workers had been injured, detained, disappeared and killed.


The report said attacks on healthcare infrastructure and medical personnel were not isolated incidents, but formed part of a broader pattern in which protected medical facilities and personnel were systematically endangered or directly targeted. MAF-DAD said there were reasonable grounds to believe that these acts constituted war crimes.


Detention, torture and enforced disappearances


The report said cases of detention and disappearance occurred following the capture of Sheikh Maqsoud and Ashrafiah and at checkpoints along routes used by fleeing civilians.


Witnesses said men were separated from women and children, detainees were held in severely overcrowded facilities and their families were given no information about them.


People interviewed by MAF-DAD reported beatings, electric shocks, blindfolding, handcuffing, forced confessions and statements, inadequate food and water, poor hygiene and denial of access to healthcare.


The report said there were reasonable grounds to believe that these practices could constitute war crimes, including arbitrary detention, cruel treatment, torture, enforced disappearance or hostage-taking. It added that, where the necessary legal requirements were met, they could also amount to crimes against humanity.


Mutilation and humiliation of the dead


The report also documented serious violations involving the bodies of the dead.


MAF-DAD said it had examined direct photographic and video evidence showing the mutilation of bodies, the public display of corpses, the cutting of women’s hair or braids, the removal of tattoos from bodies and the severing of certain body parts.


Witnesses also said families had been prevented from burying the dead with dignity and that bereaved relatives had been subjected to degrading treatment.


The report said these acts were accompanied by racist, sectarian and sexist insults. MAF-DAD found reasonable grounds to believe that the acts were intended to humiliate and intimidate …

author: Mag
title: Keine Wehrpflicht! Für niemand! Wehrpflicht für Frauen ist kein Ausweis von Gleichberechtigung
content:
„Das Grundgesetz für die BRD, das im Mai 1949 in Kraft trat, sah nach dem Willen des Parlamentarischen Rats keinen Wehrdienst – weder freiwillig noch verpflichtend – vor. Offenbar wissen das die meisten Menschen heute gar nicht mehr. »Nie wieder Faschismus! Nie wieder Krieg!«, lautete damals die Parole. Politiker:innen aller Parteien sprachen sich gegen eine Wiederbewaffnung aus. Als 1950 nach Beginn des Koreakriegs die Parolen über eine Gefahr aus dem Osten zunahmen, vor der sich auch die neugegründete Bundesrepublik schützen müsse, und als bekannt wurde, dass Kanzler Adenauer (CDU) die Wiederbewaffnung für die Bundesrepublik vorbereiten ließ, wuchs die Angst, dass eine Aufrüstung der BRD die Gefahr eines erneuten Krieges beinhalten würde. (…) Es gab Protest- und Schweigemärsche und viele Formen des Widerstands. Frauen schlossen sich in der neu gegründeten westdeutschen Frauenfriedensbewegung (WFFB) oder der seit 1915 bestehenden Internationalen Frauenliga für Frieden und Freiheit (IFFF) zusammen, um dagegen zu protestieren…“

Artikel von Gisela Notz in der SoZ vom 25. September 2026


 und mehr daraus:


Weiter aus dem

Artikel von Gisela Notz in der SoZ vom 25. September 2026


: „

(…) Am 7.Juli 1956 verabschiedete der Deutsche Bundestag das Wehrpflichtgesetz, das am 21.Juli in Kraft trat. 269 Abgeordnete stimmten für das Gesetz und 166 dagegen, 20 enthielten sich der Stimme. Damit entschied sich der Bundestag beim Aufbau der Bundeswehr für eine Wehrpflichtarmee. Nach Art.12a Abs.1 GG wurden alle deutschen Männer vom vollendeten 18.Lebensjahr an zum Dienst an der Waffe in den Streitkräften, im Bundesgrenzschutz oder in einem Zivilschutzverband verpflichtet. Frauen wurde nach Art.12a Abs.4 GG der Dienst mit der Waffe verboten. Eine Öffnung der Bundeswehr oder gar die Wehrpflicht für Frauen waren kein Gegenstand öffentlich geführter Diskussionen. Auch nicht in der DDR, wo die Wehrpflicht 1962 eingeführt wurde. In der BRD können 18- bis 25jährige Frauen seit 1968 nach Art.12a Abs.4 GG, allerdings im Verteidigungsfall, zu Dienstleistungen im zivilen Sanitätsdienst der Bundeswehr und in der stationären und ambulanten Krankenpflege verpflichtet werden. Auch dagegen gab es damals Widerstand. (…)


Im Juni 1979 traten Gewerkschaftsfrauen und Frauen aus autonomen Zusammenhängen mit einem Aufruf »Frauen in die Bundeswehr? – Wir sagen nein!« an die Öffentlichkeit. Sie vertraten die Position, dass sich ein würdiges Leben für Frauen und Männer nur entfalten kann, wenn die Gesellschaft entmilitarisiert wird. (…)


Seit Januar 2001 stehen Frauen neben den zivilen auch sämtliche militärische Laufbahnen offen. Die Elektronikerin Tanja Kreil hat das vor dem Europäischen Gerichtshof erstritten. Die Idee für die EU-Klage hatten Alice Schwarzer und die damalige Staatssekretärin im Verteidigungsministerium, Michaela Geiger (CDU). Unterstützt wurden sie vom Bundeswehrverband. (…)

Nach der Änderung des Grundgeseztes am 19.Dezember 2000 ist auch der Dienst an der Waffe für Frauen nicht mehr kategorisch ausgeschlossen. Der zweite Satz von Art.12a Abs.4 GG lautet nun: Frauen »dürfen auf keinen Fall zum Dienst mit der Waffe verpflichtet werden«. Das heißt, sie dürfen freiwillig schießen lernen, niemand darf sie aber dazu zwingen. Als emanzipatorischer Erfolg kann das nicht gefeiert werden. Die Bundeswehr ist kein Arbeitgeber wie jeder andere. Sie übt täglich für den Ernstfall und ist auf absolutem Befehl und Gehorsam aufgebaut. Sie schafft keine Arbeitsplätze, sondern »Todesplätze« (Robert Jungk). 2011 wurde die Wehrpflicht per Beschluss des Bundestags ausgesetzt. Grund war die veränderte Sicherheits- und verteidigungspolitische Lage. Sie blieb jedoch im Grundgesetz bestehen und die Aussetzung gilt nur in Friedenszeiten, im Spannungs- oder Verteidigungsfall kann sie wieder aktiviert werden. Seit dem Krieg in der Ukraine und der angeblich »realen Bedrohung durch Russland muss man auf eine Eskalation vorbereitet sein«, heißt es nun wieder, »Deutschland muss wieder kriegstüchtig werden.« (…)


Die Partei Die Linke stellte am 4.September 2025 den Antrag an den Bundestag, den Art.12a GG, ersatzlos zu streichen. Damit wäre der Status quo der vom Parlamentarischen Rat verabschiedeten Verfassung wieder hergestellt. Die Vertreter:innen aller anderen Parteien reagierten auf diesen Vorschlag bei der Anhörung am 11.September 2025 mit komplettem Unverständnis und Beschimpfungen wegen fehlender Heimatliebe, Ablehnung der Vaterlandsverteidigung und …

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Afghans "Have Been the Victims" of U.S. Military, Taliban, Cartels & More for Decades: Nagieb Khaja
content:
Award-winning Danish Afghan journalist and filmmaker Nagieb Khaja’s most recent documentary,

Winning Heart and Minds

, is an investigation into what went wrong in the U.S.-led war in Afghanistan. In the film, Khaja travels to Musa Qala, the capital of the southern Helmand province. Danish and British troops had been deployed to Musa Qala in 2006 to defend their allies, the local police, against Taliban insurgents.


While urban areas benefited from U.S. occupation during the war, “Western forces allied themselves with forces that in rural Afghanistan were considered worse than the Taliban,” says Khaja. “The police forces and the warlords that were fighting side by side with American, Danish and British forces, they were drug cartels, they were ruthless criminals, they were rapists.”

title: NAZA, la guerra di Israele contro i testimoni e la complicità dei media
content:
A Washington, la violazione dell’accesso alla stampa americana da parte di Donald Trump ha suscitato indignazione e sfida; a Tel Aviv, il divieto generalizzato imposto da Benjamin Netanyahu agli stessi media, con pretesti falsi, ottiene solo obbedienza e silenzio.


Di

Jamal Kanj

 – 24 settembre 2026 da

Invicta Palestina


Quando Israele ha vietato l’accesso a Gaza ai giornalisti internazionali nell’ottobre 2023, la motivazione addotta era la loro “sicurezza”, sostenendo che i corrispondenti non potevano essere protetti in una zona di guerra attiva. Un anno dopo il cessate il fuoco unilaterale, la giustificazione di Israele è stata invalidata, eppure il divieto rimane. Lasciandosi alle spalle, incontrollato, il più grande cimitero del mondo, e un esercito occupante che continua a rifiutarsi di permettere alla stampa internazionale di vedere cosa vi è sepolto.


Nell’aprile del 2026, l’Associazione della Stampa Estera, insieme al Comitato per la Protezione dei Giornalisti, a Giornalisti Senza Frontiere e all’Unione dei Giornalisti in Israele, presentò una petizione alla Corte Suprema israeliana per porre fine al divieto militare di ingresso a Gaza per i giornalisti stranieri, sostenendo che era in vigore un “cessate il fuoco”, che tutti i prigionieri erano stati rilasciati e che non vi era alcuna minaccia concreta per i giornalisti. Il governo si oppose alla petizione, invocando questa volta la guerra con l’Iran come nuova giustificazione. Le scuse continuavano a cambiare. Il divieto no.


Ciò che non è cambiato è il prezzo pagato dai giornalisti palestinesi per svolgere il lavoro che Israele non permette a nessun altro di fare. Centinaia di giornalisti locali sono stati uccisi, più che in tutte le guerre messe insieme dalla guerra del Vietnam. Tre di loro sono morti insieme nel gennaio del 2026, dopo il “cessate il fuoco”, documentando un Genocidio. Il messaggio era chiaro: con i corrispondenti stranieri fuori, assassinate i giornalisti palestinesi e seppellite i Crimini di Guerra insieme ai bambini sotto le macerie.


Lo stesso copione israeliano si ripete in Cisgiordania, dove la minaccia è rappresentata dalle folle ebraiche, che lo Stato rafforza. Quando i giornalisti hanno denunciato le violenze dei giovani Sionisti a Jannatah, vicino a Betlemme, nell’agosto del 2026, i soldati hanno dichiarato l’area “zona militare chiusa” e hanno ordinato ai media di andarsene, mentre le folle di giovani che li avevano attaccati continuavano la loro furia. A Hebron, l’esercito ha designato la casa di un difensore dei diritti umani palestinese come zona militare chiusa dopo che questi aveva denunciato molestie da parte di coloni ebrei illegali, isolando l’area e impedendo ai giornalisti di documentare le prove delle attività criminali. Israele non chiude queste zone per fermare i linciaggi da parte di folle ebraiche; le dichiara “zone militari” non appena arrivano le telecamere, trasformando il potere dell’esercito in una cortina per nascondere i crimini dei giovani ebrei.


Questo era il piano fin dall’inizio. Controllare il discorso richiedeva il controllo dei testimoni: tenere fuori la stampa, uccidere i giornalisti che portavano quelle telecamere “minacciose” e lasciare che il Goebbels Sionista diffondesse la sua Hasbara (Propaganda Sionista) per offuscare la verità. Tra i principali argomenti del discorso “Israele prima di tutto” c’era l’affermazione che il rapporto tra civili e combattenti uccisi a Gaza fosse migliore di quello americano in Iraq o in Afghanistan. Era una statistica fatta su misura per le emittenti televisive via cavo, precisa, autorevole e impossibile da verificare in modo indipendente, perché coloro che avrebbero potuto controllarla erano stati esclusi dalle stesse testate giornalistiche dal contestare l’affermazione, banditi dall’ingresso a Gaza o già uccisi.


Ecco perché il documentario israeliano NAZA ha ricevuto l’attenzione che ha ricevuto. Il suo titolo deriva dall’acronimo militare ebraico Nezek Agavi, un termine agghiacciante che indica il numero di civili che si prevede vengano uccisi e che viene preso in considerazione dalle valutazioni dei servizi segreti israeliani quando si prendono decisioni sugli obiettivi a Gaza. Il film è stato realizzato dai registi israeliani premio Oscar Yuval Abraham e Rachel Szor.

author: PETA-Team
title: Geheimsache Tierversuche: Neue ZDF-Doku zeigt Tierleid hinter verschlossenen Labortüren
content:
Symbolbild


Die neue „37°“-Dokumentation „Geheimsache Tierversuche – Unter Ausschluss der Öffentlichkeit“ geht der Frage nach, was eigentlich mit Tieren in Versuchslaboren geschieht – und warum die Öffentlichkeit so wenig davon sehen darf.


Am 

29. September 2026 um 22:15 Uhr im ZDF

 sehen die Zuschauer:innen hinter die Kulissen einer Branche, in der Mäuse, Ratten, Hunde, Affen, Kaninchen, Schweine und viele weitere Tiere für Experimente missbraucht werden.


Millionen Tiere leiden für „wissenschaftliche Zwecke“


Nach den offiziellen Zahlen wurden in Deutschland

im Jahr 2024 über drei Millionen Tiere

 für „wissenschaftliche Zwecke“ missbraucht. Einen großen Teil nimmt die Grundlagenforschung ein, in der Tieren zum Beispiel der Schädel aufgebohrt wird, um Elektroden in ihr Gehirn zu setzen. In regulatorischen, gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Tests werden die Tiere teils vergiftet und getötet.


Solche Experimente finden nicht irgendwo weit entfernt statt, sondern an verschiedenen Forschungseinrichtungen in Deutschland.

Experimente an Affen

, die in der Dokumentation ebenfalls thematisiert werden, sind in der Hälfte der Bundesländer vertreten.


Was passiert in den Versuchslaboren?


Für die Dokumentation hat der Journalist Manfred Karremann mehr als ein Jahr lang versucht, Einblicke in deutsche Tierversuchslabore zu bekommen. Trotz angebotener Anonymität erklärte sich nur eine Einrichtung bereit, ein wenig Einblick zu geben.


Die Dokumentation macht damit ein Problem sichtbar, das Tierschützer:innen seit Jahren kritisieren: Tierversuche finden weitgehend im Verborgenen statt. Sie werden verharmlost und die wenigsten Menschen erfahren, was den Tieren tatsächlich angetan wird. Dabei geht es um Lebewesen, die Angst und Schmerzen empfinden wie wir – und die schlichtweg nicht dazu da sind, dass wir an ihnen experimentieren.


Die Dokumentation zeigt unter anderem Aufnahmen aus einem britischen Labor. Zu sehen sind Hunde,

Affen

, Kaninchen und Ratten, die für sogenannte

Giftigkeitstests

 missbraucht werden. Die Versuche gelten als standardisierte Verfahren und werden nach internationalen Richtlinien durchgeführt – auch in der EU. Tiere müssen dabei beispielsweise Chemikalien einatmen oder bekommen Testsubstanzen über einen Schlauch direkt in den Magen verabreicht.


Jetzt lesen


Forschung und Medizin


Tierversuche in Deutschland: Was wirklich in den Versuchslaboren passiert


In deutschen Tierversuchslaboren werden Affen, Hunde, Katzen, Nagetiere, Fische & Insekten gequält. Erfahren Sie hier mehr über die Versuche!


Jetzt lesen


Tierversuche sind keine gute Wissenschaft


Tierversuche werden oft als „wissenschaftlich notwendig“ gerechtfertigt – doch die Dokumentation zeigt, dass die Wissenschaft längst mit Methoden arbeitet, die ohne Tiermissbrauch auskommen. Expert:innen aus Industrie und Wissenschaft kommen zu Wort und erklären, warum modernste Methoden wie menschliche Zellkulturen oder Organs-on-a-Chip Tierversuchen nicht nur ethisch, sondern auch wissenschaftlich überlegen sind.


Diese Ansätze arbeiten direkt mit menschlichen Zellen und menschlichem Gewebe. Dadurch können sie bei bestimmten Fragestellungen auch Erkenntnisse liefern, die sich besser auf Menschen übertragen lassen.


Jetzt einschalten und hinschauen!


Die „37°“-Dokumentation gibt einen seltenen Einblick in die abgeschottete Welt, in der Tiere in Laboren ihr Leben lang gefangen sind – und zeigt gleichzeitig, warum es längst überfällig ist, dass sich Wissenschaft und Forschung von Tierversuchen abwenden.


„37°: Geheimsache Tierversuche – Unter Ausschluss der Öffentlichkeit“

 läuft am

Dienstag, 29. September 2026, um 22:15 Uhr im ZDF.

 Ab 5:00 Uhr ist die Dokumentation auch über das ZDF-Streaming-Angebot abrufbar.


Jede Unterschrift zählt


PETA fordert von nationalen und internationalen Entscheidungsträger:innen einen strategischen Ausstieg aus Tierversuchen und eine Modernisierung der Forschung. Unterstützen Sie den Research Modernisation Deal und helfen Sie uns, grausame Tierversuche endlich zu beenden.


Jetzt unterschreiben


The post

Geheimsache Tierversuche: Neue ZDF-Doku zeigt Tierleid hinter verschlossenen Labortüren

 appeared first on

PETA Deutschland e.V.

.

title: Eggesford in the Dock: Huntsman Convicted of Illegal Hunting
content:
Eggesford Hunt huntsman Jason Marles has been convicted of illegally hunting a fox with hounds following an incident captured on drone footage during the hunt’s Boxing Day meet in December 2025.


Jason Marles, huntsman of the Eggesford Hunt.


Marles, 44, pleaded guilty to hunting a wild mammal with dogs at Pudson Farm, near Okehampton, when he appeared before Exeter Magistrates’ Court on 23 September 2026.


His conviction followed footage recorded by Devon County Hunt Saboteurs which showed a fox being bolted from an area of rubble before being pursued by hounds. Hunt saboteurs positioned on a farm track nearby were in position to stop the hounds from chasing the fox, and they confirmed that the fox managed to evade capture.


The footage shows Marles standing beside the area where the fox had taken refuge, close to a cattle barn. Two men with spades are moving rubble and digging at the site, while a child, who had dismounted from their pony, also watches what is happening.


Huntsman Jason Marles looks on as landowner Lloyd Heard and terrier-man Tom Bounsall dig and remove the rubble protecting the hunted fox. Image credit: Devon County Hunt Saboteurs.


Devon County Hunt Sabs identify the two men digging as Eggesford terrier man Tom Bounsall and landowner Lloyd Heard.


WATCH THE VIDEO


After Marles realised a drone was overhead, and they had walked back to the farmyard, Marles and Heard swapped coats in a comical, and ultimately futile attempt to avoid identification.


Huntsman Jason Marles wearing Lloyd Heard’s jacket after the dig out. Tom Bounsall follows behind on a quad. Image: Devon County Hunt Saboteurs.


Bounsall is a terrier-man for both the Eggesford Hunt and the Spooners & West Dartmoor Hunt. Pictured here at a Spooners meet in March 2026. Image: Plymouth & West Devon Hunt Sabs.


After several minutes, the fox bolts from its refuge and runs for the surrounding cover. The hounds follow, beginning the chase. No attempt to call the hounds back was made.


Heard was also charged alongside Marles with hunting offences relating to both the Boxing Day incident at Pudson Farm and a second incident near Crediton in February 2026.


As the landowner of Pudson Farm, Heard also faced a further charge under Section 3 of the Hunting Act of knowingly permitting his land to be used for hunting a wild mammal with dogs.


Lloyd Heard, landowner of Pudson Farm, where the fox was dug out and subsequently pursued by hounds. Image: Devon County Hunt Saboteurs.


The proceedings against Heard were

subsequently withdrawn by the prosecution

. No reason for that decision has been made public.


Heard also has a close family connection to the leadership of hunting’s governing body. He is the son-in-law of British Hound Sports Association

Executive Director Julian Barnfield

.


Barnfield is himself a former huntsman with previous Hunting Act convictions. Whilst huntsman of the Heythrop Hunt, he pleaded guilty to

four separate counts of unlawfully hunting foxes

 between 2011 and 2012.


Julian Barnfield (right), who turned up to Crewe Magistrates court in 2022 to support another convicted fox hunter – former Quorn Huntsman Ollie Finnegan (left). Image: Cheshire Against Blood Sports (CABS).


Barnfield also has a longstanding connection to former Prime Minister David Cameron. In 2008, when Barnfield was facing an earlier prosecution under the Hunting Act, Cameron – then leader of the Opposition and Barnfield’s constituency MP –

wrote to the Attorney General on his behalf

 following a private meeting between the two. Those proceedings against Barnfield were subsequently discontinued on a technical issue.


The connection is worth noting. The Heythrop was David Cameron’s local hunt, and

he rode with it on numerous occasions

 before the Hunting Act came into force. It is also reported that David Cameron is ‘friendly’ with Barnfield, Heard’s father-in-law.


David Cameron

 pictured with the Heythrop Hunt in 2004. Image: Daily Mail.


Cameron remains a vocal supporter of fox hunting. As recently as September 2026,

he described the incoming ban on so-called ‘trail hunting

’ as “completely wrong”, urging the minority within the rural community who support hunting to “stand together and fight together”.


None of this establishes that political connections played any part in the decision to drop the charges against Heard. But it does illustrate something that has long characterised fox hunting – those who enjoy hunting …

author: L214
title: Nourrir ou trahir. Comment l’élevage intensif saigne la France.
content:
On doit changer de modèle, découvrez comment :

Peu importe qui vous êtes et ce en quoi vous croyez : l’élevage intensif trahit vos valeurs.

Nous mangeons 85 kilos de viande par personne et par an, le double de la moyenne mondiale. Ni accident ni dérive, cette consommation de masse est le produit d’un système dont l’élevage intensif est la pierre angulaire.

Souveraineté alimentaire, santé publique, déforestation, biodiversité, ressource en eau, revenu des agriculteurs, sort des animaux : sur chacun de ces fronts, l’élevage intensif nous trahit. Il nous rend dépendants d’engrais et de soja importés, endette les éleveurs, favorise pandémies et antibiorésistance, nuit à l’environnement et entraîne l’abattage de plus de 3 millions d’animaux chaque jour pour la seule consommation française.

Nous n’avons pas choisi ce modèle. D’autres l’ont choisi pour nous. Ce livre, rédigé par Brigitte Gothière et Sébastien Arsac, cofondateurs de L214, défend une proposition pour reprendre la main ensemble : donnons-nous l’objectif de réduire de moitié le nombre d’animaux tués d’ici 2030. Parce que c’est possible. Parce que c’est vital.

d’animaux abattus chaque jour pour la seule consommation française.

Vous entrez dans un supermarché. Vous prenez un caddie. Vous suivez un itinéraire balisé. Vous voyez ce qui doit être vu, à la hauteur qu'il faut, au prix qu'il faut. Vous croisez la viande partout, les légumineuses presque nulle part. À la sortie, vous avez le sentiment d'avoir choisi.

« On nous a fait croire qu’il fallait choisir son camp : pour les agriculteurs ou pour les animaux, pour le climat ou pour la souveraineté alimentaire. Mais l’élevage intensif ne défend aucun de ces camps, il les renie tous en même temps. C’est ce que ce livre documente, chiffres à l’appui. »

« C’est un livre sur une impasse dont nous devons sortir collectivement. Réduire de moitié le nombre d’animaux tués d’ici 2030 est une nécessité, soutenue par une majorité de Français. Ceux qui croient que l’élevage intensif peut durer se bercent d’illusions. »

Nourrir ou trahir, comment l’élevage intensif saigne la France paru le 30 septembre 2026 aux éditions Payot, disponible au prix de 19 € sur notre boutique en ligne et en librairie.

title: GRASSROOTS MOVEMENT AUGUST ROUND UP
content:
There’s been some huge wins for the grassroots animal rights space in August.


Right at the start of the month, Southampton Animal Action convinced Brittany Ferries to end the live export of farmed animals from Ireland to France.


They protested and disrupted ports, offices, and shareholders across the South Coast and London for a year. Concerned the protests might escalate to demonstrations at sea, Brittany Ferries’ CEO gave them his personal WhatsApp number, arranged a series of meetings, and agreed to end the vile trade! The win has sent the Irish farming sector into crisis mode, and they are warning that if a replacement isn’t found soon. All eyes are now on Irish Ferries, the only remaining live exporter for the Irish farming industry. This is an incredible opportunity for our grassroots movement to strike a powerful blow against the dairy industry.


More incredible news from Scotland as grassroots activists and national organisation Protect the Wild have just saved 4,000 lives!


Following a sustained campaign against the Guga Hunt, which sees ten men from the Scottish island of Lewis bludgeon baby gannets to death for a local delicacy, the hunt’s licence has been revoked! In support of the Protect the Wild campaign, grassroots activists smashed windows, painted buildings, and occupied rooftops. The licence will not be issued for 2026, and the licensing body, NatureScot, has indicated this will continue through 2027. Gannets are an endangered species, and the licence is allowed only because of a deliberate loophole in the law. Campaigners are now pushing to close this loophole and make the hunt permanently illegal.


MBR Acres, the notorious puppy factory that breeds dogs for research, continues to sink into shit. Quite literally, it turns out, as their waste management company pulled out, leaving them stacking tonnes of dog poo in rubble sacks behind their buildings. The MBR Suppliers campaign (www.mbrsuppliers.is or MBR Suppliers on FB) is impressively deconstructing the company, leaving them with no working toilets (for the last year!), no gardeners (their security have to trim the hedges to allow lorries in), at risk of being delisted from Companies House, and their £250,000 office building remains unfinished because no one wants to build it.


The National Animal Rights March saw thousands of people marching for animal freedom in London. This is the fifth month in a row that activists have taken to the UK streets en masse for the animals! The Animal Freedom Network has announced that 25 local animal rights communities have formed as part of their efforts to help support and grow the grassroots space. An exciting initiative that is already seeing great results! Their national gathering is on September 25-27 – more info at www.animalfreedom.org.uk.

title: Guilty Verdict For King’s Sheep Rescuers In Theft Trial
content:
After a four-day trial at Norwich Crown Court, Rose Patterson, Sarah Foy, and Rosa Sharkey have all been found guilty of theft after the rescue of three lambs from King Charles III’s Sandringham Estate in May 2023. Sentencing to follow today.

Despite the verdict, Animal Rising claims that the rescue and subsequent trial have helped to put a spotlight on the reality behind animal farming in the UK, with over 10 million sheep being slaughtered yearly [1].

The controversial rescue made front-page news across the UK and headlines around the world [2]. It captured the attention of the British public, questioning how we relate to animals in the food system and if it’s a rescue or a theft to take them from farms.

Animal Rising director Rose Patterson, alongside Rosa Sharkey and Sarah Foy, rescued the lambs - Sammy, Sunny and Sooty - before informing police the following day. The women held signs outside Windsor Castle reading “I rescued the King’s sheep” before reporting what they had done to police. They each face up to 7 years' imprisonment.

Earlier this year, Patterson was found not guilty by a jury over another Animal Rising open rescue, after helping to rescue beagle puppies from MBR Acres, a facility breeding animals for testing [3].

Animal Rising director Rose Patterson, one of the three defendants found guilty today, said:

Sammy, Sunny and Sooty remain safe and are now fully grown.

The trial followed a series of open-rescue trials relating to Animal Rising’s rescue of beagles from MBR Acres. In January this year, Animal Rising made history by securing the UK’s first-ever not-guilty verdict in an open-rescue case [4]. The lambs were rescued from Appleton Farm, which forms part of the Sandringham estate.

Defendants Patterson and Foy are available for comment or broadcast interview upon request.

For further information, comment, or to arrange an interview, please email press@animalrising.org or call +44 1225 29 6691

High-Quality Pictures and Videos: https://show.pics.io/animal-rising-breaking-news

All images and videos in this file, on our social media, and website can be used with credit to Animal Rising under ‘fair use’ for the purposes of reporting.

[2] https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-12431619/Animal-Rising-protesters-charged-stealing-Kings-sheep-royal-Sandringham-Estate-driving-away-animals.html

https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-12126009/Will-stop-eco-clowns-Just-Stop-Oil-throw-orange-powder-Animal-Rising-kidnap-lambs.html

[3] https://www.cambsnews.co.uk/peterborough-court-acquittal-animal-rescue-beagles/

Rose Patterson, 37, is the Director of Animal Rising. An advocate for animals since 2012, she holds an MSc in Animal Welfare Science, Ethics, and Law and previously worked with World Animal Protection before joining Animal Rising in 2020.

Sarah Foy, 26, has been involved in a range of campaigns advocating for a just and sustainable food system that works for animals, farmers, and the planet. She brings a practical, hands-on approach to her advocacy, with real-world experience caring for rescued farm animals at sanctuaries and protesting alongside farmers.

Rosa Sharkey, 26, is a food charity worker. She is passionately committed to reducing the impact of our food system on the climate crisis, community action, and animal rights.

Animal Rising is a nonviolent campaign group working to fundamentally transform our relationship with animals and nature, and build a more sustainable future for animals, people and the planet. Animal Rising is calling on the Government to end factory farming by 2040 and support a transition to a sustainable plant-based food system.

The group has used a variety of civil disobedience and nonviolent direct action tactics, notably blockading McDonald's distribution centres in May 2021, blockading dairy industry sites in September 2022, disrupting the 2023 Grand National, rescuing lambs belonging to King Charles III in May 2023, and carrying out the UK’s largest undercover farm investigation in 2024.

author: Sophie Lemcke
title: So ist es, als Huhn in der Fleischindustrie leben zu müssen
content:
Die Hühnermast ist ein grausames System, das auf maximale Schnelligkeit, Wachstum und Profit ausgelegt ist und mit einem gewaltvollen Tod für die Tiere endet.


Wie fühlt es sich an, als „Masthuhn“ geboren zu werden

, ohne die Möglichkeit, der leidvollen Industrie zu entkommen

?


Der einzige Grund, weshalb die Industrie dich „produziert“ hat: Du sollst so schnell wie möglich so schwer wie möglich werden – und wirst dann getötet.


Du kommst in einem Hühnerschlupfbetrieb mit tausenden anderen Küken zur Welt. Um dich herum piepsen sie verzweifelt. Und auch du suchst nach Nähe und Wärme. Aber da ist keine Mutter, in deren Gefieder du dich kuscheln kannst – und du wirst sie auch niemals kennenlernen.

Noch am ersten Tag deines Lebens wirst du über Förderbänder geschleudert und in eine Kiste gepackt. Dann beginnt die oftmals stundenlange Fahrt zum Mastbetrieb – eingepfercht mit Dutzenden anderen Küken, ohne Wasser, ohne Nahrung.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Du kommst in einer riesigen Halle an. Hier wirst du die nächsten rund 5 Wochen verbringen – die einzigen Wochen deines Lebens.


Um dich herum Tausende andere Küken. Du teilst dir einen Quadratmeter mit bis zu 23 anderen Tieren. Jetzt seid ihr noch klein, doch das wird sich schnell ändern.


Du wächst. Unnatürlich schnell. Das Futter steht dir Tag und Nacht zur Verfügung – hochkalorisch, proteinreich, entwickelt für maximales Wachstum in kürzester Zeit.


Du hast keinen Platz, um dich natürlich zu bewegen, es gibt nichts zum Erkunden. Keinerlei Möglichkeiten, deine natürlichen Verhaltensweisen auszuleben. Es ist trist und laut. Da ist nur diese Enge.


Die Luft ist stickig. Der Ammoniakgeruch von den Ausscheidungen Tausender Tiere brennt in deinen Augen, in deinen Lungen. Du bekommst Atemwegserkrankungen. Jeder Atemzug tut weh.


Dein Körper wurde durch jahrzehntelange Züchtung so manipuliert, dass du in wenigen Wochen das Gewicht erreichst, für das ein Huhn unter natürlichen Bedingungen Monate bräuchte.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Deine Brustmuskeln wachsen so schnell und werden so schwer, dass deine Knochen dein Gewicht nicht mehr tragen können. Deine Beine verformen sich. Dein Herz ist zu klein für deinen massiven Körper, es hat Probleme, deine Organe mit ausreichend Blut zu versorgen. Du hast Schmerzen beim Gehen und deine Gelenke sind entzündet.


Um dich herum sind Hühner, die gar nicht mehr aufstehen können. Sie liegen in ihrem eigenen Kot und leiden unter extremen Schmerzen. Sie verdursten und verhungern.


Andere Hühner werden aufgrund der Enge von ihren Artgenossen versehentlich totgetrampelt und erdrückt – ihre Körper verwesen zwischen dir und den tausenden anderen Tieren. Auch du hast keine Chance, den anderen Hühnern auszuweichen.


Dann ist es soweit. Menschen kommen und packen dich. An deinen Beinen, kopfüber, werden du und deine Artgenossen gegriffen und in enge Transportkisten geworfen. Deine ohnehin schon schmerzenden Beine brechen unter der groben Behandlung. Du hast Schmerzen und Todesangst.


Zusammengepfercht, ohne Wasser, ohne Futter, geht es zum Schlachthof. Die Fahrt kann Stunden dauern. Manche Hühner sterben bereits im Transporter – vor Stress, vor Erschöpfung, erdrückt von anderen Tieren.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Im Schlachthof riechst du Blut. Du hörst die Schreie anderer Hühner. Dann bist du selbst an der Reihe. Unter grausamen Bedingungen wirst du betäubt und getötet. Du bist gerade einmal 35 bis 42 Tage alt geworden.


Es ist unvorstellbar, was Hühner in der Fleischindustrie erleiden müssen.


Die Wahrheit hinter „Hähnchenfleisch“


Wie grausam das kurze Leben von sogenannten Masthühnern ist, haben wir schon mehrfach bei Undercover-Recherchen aufgedeckt, beispielsweise in einem (jetzt ehemaligen) Zuliefererbetrieb der großen Marke Wiesenhof. Hier erfährst du mehr über unsere Aufdeckungen und kannst unsere Petition für strengere Tierschutzvorgaben, -kontrollen und -strafen unterzeichnen:


Jetzt für Hühner unterschreiben 


In Deutschland wird mehr Fleisch von Hühnern konsumiert als produziert – und die Nachfrage ist in den vergangenen Jahren stetig gestiegen. Unterstütze dieses grausame System nicht: Entscheide dich konsequent für pflanzliche Lebensmittel.


In den meisten Supermärkten findest du mittlerweile eine Vielfalt tierfreundlicher Alternativen, die hervorragende Proteinquellen sind – probiere sie aus. Oder koche unsere zahlreichen pflanzlichen Rezepte von Love Veg nach, wie unsere

knusprigen Tofu-Nuggets

.

author: PETA-Team
title: Tierschutz für Kinder: Ingrid Newkirks neues Buch „Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“
content:
Mit

„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“

 lädt Ingrid Newkirk, Gründerin von PETA, Kinder ab ca. 9 Jahren zu einer besonderen Entdeckungsreise ein. Statt Fantasiegeschichten präsentiert das Kindersachbuch echte Geschichten voller

Mitgefühl

 und praktischer Tipps, wie Kinder selbst zum Wohl von Tieren beitragen können. Jedes Kapitel verbindet wissenschaftlich fundierte Fakten mit echten Geschichten aus der Tierwelt – mal berührend, mal überraschend, immer kindgerecht erzählt. Reflexionsfragen regen dazu an, über Verantwortung, Empathie und Gerechtigkeit nachzudenken. Damit fördert das Buch nicht nur Lesekompetenz, sondern auch zentrale Werte wie Mitgefühl und die Fähigkeit zum Perspektivwechsel.


Lesen Sie jetzt im Interview, welche Gedanken Ingrid zu „Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ inspiriert haben, welche Vision dahintersteckt und weshalb es so wichtig ist, Kindern Tierschutz näherzubringen.


Kostenlos „Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ bestellen


Ein Blick ins Buch: Gemeinsam stark für Tiere


Ingrid Newkirk zeigt in ihrem neuen Werk, dass jedes Kind auch ohne Zauberkräfte einen Unterschied machen kann. Die Geschichten handeln von Tieren, die überraschen, berühren und zum Nachdenken anregen: vom mutigen Schweinchen Prudence bis hin zu Tieren, die Kinder vielleicht nie persönlich kennenlernen werden, die aber ebenso unseren

Schutz

 brauchen. Dazu gibt es Fragen zum Weiterdenken und Ideen für eigene Tierschutzaktionen – ob im Klassenzimmer, in Projekten oder im Alltag.


Das Kindersachbuch zeigt: Tiere sind nicht für uns da, sondern mit uns hier. Und Kinder können schon heute viel dazu beitragen, dass die Welt für alle Lebewesen gerechter und freundlicher wird.


Ergänzt werden die Erzählungen durch konkrete Anregungen, wie junge Leser:innen selbst aktiv werden können: ob durch kleine Gesten im Alltag, kreative Ideen für mehr Tierschutz oder den bewussten Umgang mit Mitgeschöpfen. So wird das Buch zu einer Schatzkiste voller Inspiration, die Neugier weckt und zu eigenen guten Taten motiviert.


„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ jetzt auch als Lesehörbuch entdecken

 


„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ ist nicht nur als Kindersachbuch erhältlich, sondern auch als Lesehörbuch. In Kooperation mit der Werkstatt inklusiver Deutschunterricht (WiDu) wurde das Lesehörbuch für Bildungseinrichtungen nach dem Leseband-Konzept aufbereitet. So können Kinder die Geschichten gleichzeitig lesen und anhören. Das fördert die Lesekompetenz, unterstützt den Lernprozess und macht es noch leichter, in die faszinierende Welt der Tiere einzutauchen. 


„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“: Ingrid Newkirk im Interview über ihr Buch


1. Über das Buch


Was hat Sie dazu motiviert, dieses Buch zu schreiben?

Alle Kinder möchten sich für Tiere starkmachen, und ich finde die Idee großartig, ihnen praktische Tipps zu geben, wie sie wunderbare Taten vollbringen können, die wirklich zählen.


Was macht dieses Buch im Vergleich zu anderen Kinderbüchern über Tiere besonders?

Es ist keine Fantasiegeschichte wie „Captain Irgendwas“ oder „Super Dies und Das“, sondern zeigt, wie man wirklich wichtig sein kann – nicht nur so tut, als ob –, indem man kleine Dinge tut, die das Leben von Tieren verändern. Und die meisten Kinder interessieren sich sehr für Tiere.


Warum ist es Ihrer Meinung nach wichtig, Kindern schon früh Tierschutz und Mitgefühl nahezubringen?

Wahrscheinlich gibt es nichts Wichtigeres. Wie ein antiker Philosoph sagte: Wenn man einem Kind beibringt, freundlich zu einer Raupe zu sein, tut man damit dem Kind genauso viel Gutes wie der Raupe. Mitgefühl verhindert Kriege – und selbst kleinere Aggressionen.


Wie haben Sie die Tiere ausgewählt, die im Buch vorkommen?

Kinder kennen

Hunde

 und Katzen, vielleicht auch Pferde und Eichhörnchen – deshalb sind sie im Buch. Aber auch Tiere wie Schlangen oder

Mäuse

, die oft als gruselig empfunden werden, und Tiere, die Kinder vermutlich nie zu Gesicht bekommen, die aber trotzdem unseren Schutz brauchen – zum Beispiel in Afrika oder Südamerika.


Gibt es eine Geschichte oder ein Tier in dem Buch, das Ihnen besonders am Herzen liegt?

Ich liebe alle Geschichten und hoffe, dass die Kinder sie auch alle lieben werden. Besonders gefällt mir die Geschichte von Prudence, dem kleinen Schweinchen, das wusste, dass sein Mensch sehr krank war – und sein eigenes Leben riskierte, um Hilfe zu holen. Sie zeigt, wie aufmerksam Tiere sind, selbst solche, die oft als „nicht besonders intelligent“ gelten, und wie viel Güte sie …

title: MENDIP FARMERS HUNT TO FACE TRIAL OVER HUNTED FOX
content:
Three people associated with the Mendip Farmers Hunt have pleaded not guilty to hunting a wild mammal with dogs.


Emma Clothier, Charlie Thomas and Bill Payne appeared at Taunton Deane Magistrates’ Court on 15 September 2026. All three pleaded not guilty and are due to face trial on 15 September 2027.


Emma Clothier (l) Charlie Thomas (c) and Bill Payne (r) .

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The case relates to events on 17th January 2026, when the Mendip Farmers Hunt met at their kennels in Priddy, Somerset.


Mendip Hunt Sabs were with the hunt throughout the day and documented the day’s events, including from the air using a drone. After the meet, sabs reviewed the footage they had recorded.


The footage shows hounds working inside thick bramble for several minutes before a fox breaks cover. A group of hunters can be seen on an adjoining track, including two people on horseback and a person on foot, while other mounted riders can be seen around the bramble.


The person on foot is standing only a short distance from where the fox emerges and can be seen pointing in the direction in which the fox runs.


The fox breaks cover from the thick bramble.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The hounds immediately give chase.


Within approximately a minute, the hounds catch the fox. The drone records the pack converging on the animal and the fox being killed.


The kill site was only a few hundred yards from where members of the hunt had been gathered near the patch of bramble. The drone continued filming for several minutes afterwards. During that time, no hunt member can be seen approaching the kill site, while further hounds can be seen joining the pack and tearing at the fox.


The hounds being allowed to mutilate the fox’s body.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


No attempt to retrieve the fox’s body was recorded by the drone, and eventually the hunt can be seen moving away from the area.


After reviewing their footage, Mendip Hunt Sabs returned to the location. There they discovered the mutilated body of the fox still lying where the hounds had killed her.


The mutilated fox remains were subsequently found by sabs who returned to the kill site.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The drone footage was subsequently featured in a

Channel 4 News investigation by Chief Correspondent Alex Thomson

 into the reality behind so-called “trail hunting” allegations that it is being used as a smokescreen for illegal fox hunting.


Among the footage broadcast was the

Mendip Farmers fox kill

. Channel 4 News also showed footage involving the Duke of Beaufort Hunt, including foxes being pursued and killed by hounds, one of those incidents has also resulted in three Beaufort hunters appearing in court, with a trial due to take place in April 2027.


A fox being killed by hounds belonging to the Beaufort Hunt also featured in the Channel 4 News report.

Image Credit Wiltshire Hunt Sabs.


The investigation also featured footage from the Eggesford Hunt showing a fox being bolted from underground; and covert-camera footage of the Heythrop Hunt showing chicken carcasses being dumped in woodland intended to attract foxes for hunting once the season begins.


Eggesford Hunt preparing to bolt a fox in front of the hounds.

Image Credit: Devon County Hunt Saboteurs


Also present with the Mendip Farmers Hunt on the day of the incident, was Helena Rees-Mogg, wife of former Conservative cabinet minister and former North East Somerset MP Sir Jacob Rees-Mogg.


Jacob Rees-Mogg hosting the Mendip Farmers Hunt at his home in West Harptree, on Boxing Day 2025.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The Rees-Mogg family’s association with the Mendip Farmers Hunt is longstanding. Helena Rees-Mogg has previously served as a master of the hunt, while the family has often hosted Mendip Farmers Hunt meets at their Somerset home.


Helena Anne Beatrix Wentworth Fitzwilliam, Lady Rees-Mogg , former master of the Mendip Farmers Hunt, image taken on the day of the incident 17/01/2026.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


Their eldest son, Peter Theodore Alphege Rees-Mogg, has also served as master of the Eton College Beagles.


A hunt saboteur spokesperson said “

It is down to the relentless work of hunt sabs around the country – getting out there week after week, saving lives, filming hunts, gathering evidence and putting it in front of the police – that we are finally seeing so many hunters charged with hunting offences.


Whether they are convicted …

title: Michel-Édouard Leclerc, président de l’élevage intensif
content:

Jeremstar interpelle Michel-Édouard Leclerc

L214 s’invite au Prix Landerneau des lecteurs fondé par Michel-Édouard Leclerc

Une barquette géante remise à Michel-Edouard Leclerc

Dans son dernier livre, Michel-Édouard Leclerc nous donne sa vision de l’économie. Sans un mot pour les animaux. Et si nous profitions de la sortie de son livre pour susciter un engagement ?

Commandez gratuitement un lot de marque-pages

Rendez-vous dans votre librairie ou centre commercial de proximité

Glissez un exemplaire du marque-page dans chaque livre écrit par Michel-Edouard Leclerc !

Toutes les décorations de fêtes ont été commandées ! Si vous souhaitez tout de même participer à cette action, téléchargez et imprimez des décorations militantes sur ce lien. Merci d’agir pour les animaux avec L214 !

Les champs suivis d’un astérisque (*) sont obligatoires. Les commandes ne sont possibles qu’en France métropolitaine.

Demandons à E.Leclerc de tourner le dos aux pires pratiques d’élevage en s’engageant sur les critères du Pig Minimum Standards.

Contre la souffrance des animaux, agissez à nos côtés avec un don.

Choisissez le montant de votre don

Le Pig Minimum Standards (PMS) est un référentiel comprenant 9 critères liés aux conditions d’élevage et d’abattage des cochons. Il est soutenu par plusieurs associations de défense des animaux en France et en Europe.

L214 a fait un pas vers E.Leclerc en demandant à la chaîne de supermarchés de s’engager sur un nombre limité de critères du Pig Minimum Standards, dont la faisabilité ne peut être contestée. Il s’agit de s’approvisionner, d’ici 2030, uniquement auprès d’élevages :

respectant la réglementation en vigueur (fin des mutilations systématiques, de la castration sans anesthésie des porcelets et enrichissement de l’environnement des cochons) ;

ne recourant plus aux cages pour les truies.

Ces critères constituent aujourd’hui le strict minimum pour réduire les souffrances des cochons dans les élevages intensifs. De nombreuses entreprises se sont déjà engagées, comme Pizza Cosy, Boulangerie Ange, Best Western, Marie Blachère, Big Fernand ou encore Columbus Café & Co.

title: Bir nehir veya orman dava açabilir mi?
content:
Bir ormanın varlığını sürdürme, bir nehrin kendi adına hukuk önünde temsil edilme hakkı olabilir mi? Ekvador ve Yeni Zelanda, doğanın hak sahibi olarak tanınmasına farklı yollarla kapı açtı. Bu yaklaşım, çevrenin insanlara sağladığı yararların ötesinde, doğanın kendi varlığının da hukuki korumaya değer olduğunu kabul ediyor. Peki ya Türkiye'de benzer hukuki düzenlemeler var mı? Ya da var olanlar ne kadar uygulanıyor. 


Ekvador, 2008 Anayasası’nda doğanın varlığının, yaşam döngülerinin ve evrimsel süreçlerinin korunmasını hak olarak tanımladı. Anayasa, doğanın zarar gördüğünde onarılma hakkını da tanırken, kişilere ve topluluklara bu hakların korunmasını kamu makamlarından talep etme yetkisi verdi. Böylece bir ekosistemin savunulması için insanların uğradığı zararın yanı sıra doğanın kendi haklarının ihlali de hukuki dayanak hâline geldi.


EKVADOR ANAYASASI

YEDİNCİ BÖLÜM

Doğanın hakları


Madde 71. Yaşamın yeniden üretildiği ve gerçekleştiği yer olan doğa veya Pacha Mama, varlığına ve yaşam döngülerinin, yapısının, işlevlerinin ve evrimsel süreçlerinin korunmasına ve yenilenmesine yönelik bütünsel saygıya hak kazanmıştır.


Tüm kişiler, topluluklar, halklar ve uluslar, doğanın haklarını korumak için kamu yetkililerinden yardım isteyebilirler. Bu hakların uygulanması ve yorumlanmasında, Anayasada belirtilen ilkeler gerektiği şekilde gözetilmelidir.


Devlet, doğayı korumak ve bir ekosistemi oluşturan tüm unsurlara saygıyı teşvik etmek amacıyla gerçek kişilere, tüzel kişilere ve topluluklara teşvikler sağlayacaktır.


Madde 72. Doğanın eski haline getirilme hakkı vardır. Bu eski haline getirme, devletin ve gerçek kişilerin veya tüzel kişilerin, etkilenen doğal sistemlere bağımlı bireylere ve topluluklara tazminat ödeme yükümlülüğünden ayrıdır.


Yenilenebilir olmayan doğal kaynakların sömürülmesi de dahil olmak üzere, ciddi veya kalıcı çevresel etkilerin olduğu durumlarda, Devlet, restorasyonu sağlamak için en etkili mekanizmaları kuracak ve zararlı çevresel sonuçları ortadan kaldırmak veya hafifletmek için yeterli önlemler alacaktır.


Bu düzenlemenin somut karşılıklarından biri Los Cedros Ormanı’nda ortaya çıktı. Ekvador Anayasa Mahkemesi, 2021’de ormandaki madencilik arama faaliyetlerine verilen çevresel izinleri inceledi. Mahkeme, doğanın haklarının yanı sıra su ve sağlıklı çevrede yaşama haklarının da ihlal edildiğine hükmetti; ilgili çevresel izinleri geçersiz kıldı. Ormanın biyolojik çeşitliliği ve ekolojik süreçleri, kararın merkezinde yer aldı. (

Ekvador Anayasa Mahkemesi’nin Los Cedros kararı)


Mahkeme, Ekvador Anayasası'nda yer alan tüm haklar gibi doğa haklarının da tam bir normatif güce sahip olduğunu ve sadece idealler veya retorik beyanlar değil, yasal zorunluluklar olduğunu kesin bir dille ifade etti.


Mahkeme ayrıca, ihtiyat ilkesinin doğanın haklarının korunmasına uygulanabilir olduğunu teyit etmiş ve bu anayasal ilkenin idari ve yargı mercileri için gerektirdiği unsurları ve yükümlülükleri detaylandırmıştır. Bu özel davada, madencilik faaliyetine ilişkin çevre izinlerinin verilmesinde ihtiyat ilkesinin göz ardı edildiği sonucuna varmıştır. Mahkeme ayrıca, bu ilkenin su hakkı ile ilgili uygulamasını da analiz etmiş ve Los Cedros Koruma Ormanı ekosisteminin hidrolojik özelliklerini ve çevredeki toplulukların su kullanımını göz önünde bulundurarak, ihtiyat ilkesinin korunması gerektiği ve dolayısıyla bölgedeki madencilik faaliyetine izin verilmemesi gerektiği sonucuna varmıştır.


Whanganui Nehri 2017 yılından bu yana tüzel kişilik sayılıyor


Dünyada hak alanı genişliyor


Yeni Zelanda’da ise 2017’de kabul edilen bir yasayla Whanganui Nehri’ne tüzel kişilik tanındı. Düzenleme, nehirle tarihsel, kültürel ve manevi bağları bulunan Māori topluluklarının uzun yıllara yayılan mücadelesinin ardından geldi. Yasa, nehri kaynağından denize kadar uzanan, fiziksel ve manevi unsurlarıyla bölünmez, yaşayan bir bütün olarak tanımladı.


Nehrin adına hareket etmek ve çıkarlarını korumak üzere iki kişiden oluşan bir temsil mekanizması kuruldu. Temsilcilerden birinin nehirle ilişkili Māori toplulukları, diğerinin devlet tarafından aday gösterilmesi öngörüldü. Böylece doğanın hak sahibi sayılmasıyla birlikte gündeme gelen “Onun adına kim konuşacak?” sorusuna da kurumsal bir yanıt verildi.

Yeni Zelanda Parlamentosu’nun düzenlemeye ilişkin açıklaması


Dünyada hak mücadelesinin genişlemesi ile birlikte Bolivya, Meksika, Arjantin, Brezilya, Peru, Avustralya, Kanada, ABD, Hindistan, Bengladeş, Uganda, Nijerya …

author: Dennis Pillion
title: Trump Rollback of Fuel Economy Standards Will Deal Blows to Climate and Health
content:
“There’s nothing Trump won’t sacrifice on the altar of fealty to Big Oil and auto polluters,” said one critic.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

The Trump administration Monday finalized the rollback of a major fuel economy standard for cars and trucks, a move critics say will cause more climate-warming pollution, human health problems and higher fuel costs for consumers.

The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, a part of the Department of Transportation, published new Corporate Average Fuel Economy standards Monday, greatly reducing the fuel efficiency for new passenger cars and light trucks made between 2022 and 2031.

The Department of Transportation estimates that the new standards would correspond to an industry fleetwide average of about 34.9 miles per gallon for new vehicles in model year 2031. The previous standard, set in 2022 during the Biden administration, would have required around 50.4 miles per gallon, driving automakers to invest more heavily in gasoline-free electric vehicles.

The DOT said in a news release the move would give automakers more flexibility, reduce the average cost of a new vehicle and encourage new car sales. The Trump administration continued to call the Biden rules an EV “mandate.”

“Thanks to President Trump’s leadership, we have finally ended the illegal mandate that forced automakers to produce more expensive electric vehicles that American families didn’t want,” Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said.

The Alliance for Automotive Innovation, a group that advocates on behalf of auto manufacturers, praised the new standards.

“The standards finalized under the previous administration effectively required a switchover to electric vehicles that was out of step with market realities and customer demand,” John Bozella the Alliance’s president and CEO, said in a news release. “Today’s final rule is an appropriate course correction.”

But the changes will likely mean that new cars produced will be less efficient and emit more greenhouse gases and harmful air pollutants that studies show are responsible for 9 million deaths per year worldwide.

“Today’s rule to weaken fuel economy standards will create more air pollution, harm health and accelerate climate change,” American Lung Association President and CEO Harold Wimmer said in a news release.

“For decades, fuel economy standards have ensured that new cars, SUVs and pickup trucks are more efficient, which saves lives and money,” Wimmer said. “There is no reason to weaken standards that are technologically feasible and have a direct benefit for the quality of the air people breathe.”

Transportation accounts for about 28 percent of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions, according to the Environmental Protection Agency, more than electric power generation (25 percent) or industry (23 percent).

Monday’s rule finalized plans Trump announced in December to reduce the fuel efficiency standards. But in between, the war in Iran has sent gas prices skyrocketing to an average of $4.48 per gallon, according to the American Automobile Association.

Jason Schwartz, regulatory policy director at the Institute for Policy Integrity at New York University’s School of Law, said the repeal will result in higher fuel costs for consumers and make them more vulnerable to “price shocks” in the cost of gasoline.

“The 2024 fuel-economy standards were projected to save consumers $80 billion in fuel costs and reduce more than $125 billion in damages from climate change,” Schwartz said. “Today, [the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration] made those savings disappear, and households that are already stretched thin will pay the price.”

The Institute for Policy Integrity says more than $17 billion in projected annual consumer savings are now at risk due to regulatory rollbacks by the Trump administration.

Environmental and health groups and others say they plan to contest the new standards.

“Americans need relief from high costs, but instead Trump is giving automakers a free pass on pollution and handing families the bill — at the pump and with their health,” Katherine García, director of the Sierra Club’s Clean Transportation for All program, said in a news release.

“The Sierra Club will fight this senseless rollback every step of the way,” Garcia said. “We’re going to continue to fight back against this administration’s dangerous and costly attacks on cleaner …

author: Brian Mahony
title: Coffs Harbour council rescinds climate emergency declaration
content:
Coffs Harbour City Council voted 4–3 on September 24 to rescind its 2022 declaration of a climate emergency.

The motion was put by Mayor Nikki Williams, who also sought to remove Scope 3 emissions from the council’s Renewal Energy and Emissions Reduction Plan (REERP) and delay accepting the plan for several months.

Williams stood as an independent, but local media has reported that she is a member of the National Party.

Greens Councillor Jonathan Cassell, who put the initial climate emergency motion in 2022, said council had “smash[ed] climate action in our council for the foreseeable future”.

“Climate inaction is costing us more and more, and if we aren’t prepared to act swiftly and urgently to address climate change then we are going to pay more in future.”

The 2022 motion passed 5–4, after impassioned speeches from students from local high schools who called for urgent action on climate change.

title: Yes, it’ll get worse
content:
queeranarchism

:


I’m always a bit annoyed when some ecoactivists are are all

“Hope! Degrowth! The planet can heal!”

 without giving an honest time frame for that.

Like, even if we manage to end capitalism and degrow an all of that, the CO2 that’s already in the air will continue to heat up the planet for decades and the results of that will be with us for this century at the very least.

Yes,

ecosystems can heal,

yes,

 that’s worth fighting for. But it’ll get worse before it gets better and most of us won’t be there for the good parts. You can leave that out to spread “Hope”, but all that will do is make people optimistic for a short time only for them to feel hurt and betrayed when they figure out the truth.

An worse then feeling cheated our of a bright future, people acting on this false optimistic worldview won’t build the kind of support networks that we are going to need to survive our real future. Preparing for a more ecologically unstable earth must be part of our work, even as we continue to strive for the end of capitalism an a shift to a far more sustainable way of living.

Basically, if you’re trying to boost your movement this way, your eco-activism strategy is…ehhh.. unsustainable?


What are ways we can prepare for a more ecologically unstable Earth? I honestly don’t feel very hopeful that we’re going to overthrow capitalism in time and even if we do, like you said, the Earth is going to continue to heat up. Trying to find ways to cope with and prepare for that reality actually feel more hopeful and realistic to me and I’d love to learn about them.


There are a lot of things you can do, here’s a few:

Get into the habit of sharing stuff for free with others.

We’re probably going to experience some forms of scarcity and when that happens, all we have is each other. Self-sufficiency is a myth, community self-sufficiency isn’t. Create neighborhood resources. A tool-sharing shed or a water
filter for ground or rain water could make a difference here and now,
but will also matter in the future.

Advance mode:
Start Mutual Aid collectives.

Learn first aid and other emergency medical skills.

 Whether your region is vulnerable to heat waves, wild fires, flooding, drought, extreme cold or electrical failures, there will be people in need of help an medical systems are unlikely to be able to cope with it all. Learning to take care of others is always useful, even if you’re lucky enough to not experience any disasters at all.

Advanced mode: Start a DIY medicine collective or learn an advance skill like growing medicinal herbs or physical therapy.


Learn to break the law.

As the crisis deepens, governments will let more
 and more people fall through the cracks. Refugees and undocumented
people are likely to be the first targets but other minorities can be
targetted too. Those people won’t be able to survive unless people are
willing to break the law to get them housing, food, etc.

Advanced mode:
get experience breaking the law together and put it to work actually
helping undocumented people.


Learn to support each other.

 Our mental health is as important as our physical health and to truly support each other we need more than good intentions.
Learn psychological first aid, learn how to structurally support trauma survivors, people who are mourning, people struggling with depression and more.

Advanced mode: start a Support & Recovery collective.

Work on building a community without discrimination and systematic injustice.

 All of the things to come will hit the most marginalized harder. We can only get through it together if our communities truly value everyone in it and we understand that an injury to one is an injury to all. Learn about systematic oppression, learn about privilege, learn about conflict resolution an mediation and put that to work in your community.

Advanced mode: start a transformative justice collective.

… and more.

Important: don’t take on every burden, pick a few things you enjoy doing

. None of us can do all of the above and none of us can single-highhandedly prepare our whole community for what is to come. Find a way you can support your community and trust that others will do the same.

author: CMI Argentina
title: La llegada del Super Niño, centro de preocupación en las Sierras Chicas de Córdoba
content:
La llegada de El Niño de gran intensidad vuelve a poner en el centro de la preocupación a las comunidades de Sierras Chicas, en la provincia de Córdoba, una región marcada por la inundación del 15 de febrero de 2015, por la vulnerabilidad de sus cuencas frente a lluvias intensas y por el desmanejo estatal. Vecinos, vecinas y ambientalistas reclaman medidas de prevención y coordinación entre los municipios y la Provincia, mientras advierten sobre la necesidad de contar con sistemas de alerta, protocolos de evacuación y planes ciudadanos que permitan actuar antes de una eventual emergencia.


Inundación en Rio Ceballos del 15 de febrero de 2015


Por Lucrecia Fernández para Red Eco


El escenario se encuentra además atravesado por un amparo ambiental colectivo presentado ante la Justicia de Córdoba por un grupo de ambientalistas de la región, ante el riesgo de inundaciones y lluvias extremas en las cuencas de los ríos Ceballos y Saldán. La acción tiene entre sus impulsores al abogado Juan Smith y al biólogo Raúl Montenegro, presidente de la Fundación para la Defensa del Ambiente (FUNAM).


Espacios destruidos después de las inundaciones de 2015 en Río Ceballos


La Cámara Contencioso Administrativa de Segunda Nominación admitió el trámite del amparo y convocó a una audiencia que se realizó el 23 de septiembre, con participación de representantes del Gobierno provincial y de los municipios vinculados con las cuencas. Hasta el momento, sin embargo, no se difundió información oficial sobre lo ocurrido durante esa reunión ni sobre sus resultados por parte de la Justicia, la Provincia, los municipios convocados o quienes impulsaron el amparo.


En paralelo, en Río Ceballos, una de las localidades de Sierras Chicas, Vecinas y vecinos Autoconvocados de Río Ceballos mantienen un reclamo específico ante el municipio. Días antes de la reunión mantenida el 23 de septiembre, el espacio había presentado 40 preguntas al Departamento Ejecutivo Municipal y al Concejo Deliberante para conocer las medidas previstas ante la posibilidad de lluvias extraordinarias y el comportamiento del dique La Quebrada y sus cuencas.


El riesgo ante un posible “Súper Niño”


En una entrevista con el programa

Nada de Otro Mundo

, Montenegro explicó que el escenario de riesgo en las sierras de Córdoba no puede analizarse únicamente a partir del fenómeno de El Niño, sino que debe contemplar también los efectos del cambio climático y las características de las tormentas que se producen en la provincia.


“Bueno, primero debe quedar claro que este fenómeno que se espera, que técnicamente se llama un Niño muy fuerte, después medio lo bautizaron como Súper Niño, sería el más fuerte que se haya repetido en toda la historia. Me parece que es un elemento que todos deberíamos tener en cuenta.


No solamente tenemos este fenómeno, sino que, a su vez, tenemos cambio climático global. Quiero destacar que el fenómeno del Niño, que es un fenómeno de calentamiento del océano Pacífico y que tiene efectos sobre lugares tan distantes como pueden ser Europa, el Sahara o Córdoba, es dependiente del cambio climático. Y, a su vez, el cambio climático ha hecho, por ejemplo, que aumentara la cantidad de humedad. Entonces quiere decir que se termina potenciando.


Y hay un tercer elemento que muchos cordobeses desconocen y que, por lo que parece, el propio gobierno también ha dejado de lado hace mucho tiempo: la zona centro del país, especialmente Córdoba, tiene las tormentas convectivas eléctricas más fuertes del mundo. De hecho, es un conocido objeto de estudio de muchas instituciones.


Entonces uno dice: caramba, siendo que tenemos estos sistemas convectivos de gran escala, que así se llaman estas tormentas, que son incluso más fuertes que las peores tormentas que ocurren en la zona de Estados Unidos, tenemos cambio climático, tenemos un Súper Niño”.


Montenegro sostuvo además que, en localidades como Río Ceballos, existen elementos de infraestructura que, según su planteo, podrían incrementar los riesgos ante una eventual crecida del río Ceballos. Señaló particularmente la instalación del sistema cloacal en las márgenes del curso de agua y advirtió sobre el riesgo que implicaría una eventual inundación si afectara las cañerías en funcionamiento.


Comienzo de las obras cloacales a la vera del río Ceballos


El biólogo también puso el foco en los sistemas de alerta temprana y en la preparación de la población. Según explicó, la existencia de alarmas no garantiza por sí …

title: Sicillerinde işçi ölümleri var: Maden şirketleri bu kez ‘hayat kurtarmak’ için yarıştı
content:
İktidarın “iş güvenliği” söylemleri eşliğinde Rize’de düzenlenen Maden Kurtarma Yarışması’nda, maden sahalarında işçilerin yaşamını yitirdiği şirketler bu kez “hayat kurtarmak” için yarıştı. Organizasyona katılan şirketlerin geçmişinde çok sayıda iş cinayeti bulunuyor.

Türkiye Madenciler Derneği’nin (TMD) madencilik sektöründe “iş güvenliği kültürünü pekiştirmek” iddiasıyla düzenlediği 4. Maden Kurtarma Yarışması, sermaye ile iktidarın iş güvenliği tablosundaki çelişkiyi bir kez daha ortaya koydu. İş cinayetlerinin en fazla yaşandığı işkollarından madencilik sektörünün tanıdık şirketleri, kamu kurumlarının temsilcileri ve yerel yönetimin desteğiyle bu kez kurtarma parkurunda bir araya geldi. Yarışmaya katılan 13 şirketin birçoğu daha önce iş cinayetleriyle gündeme gelirken bazı şirketlerin sahalarındaki ölümlerin üzerinden yalnızca aylar, hatta haftalar geçti.

TMD tarafından düzenlenen yarışmanın dördüncüsü, 22-25 Eylül tarihlerinde Cengiz Holding’e ait Çayeli Bakır İşletmeleri’nin ev sahipliğinde Rize’de yapıldı. AKP’li Rize Belediyesinin desteğiyle gerçekleştirilen dört günlük organizasyon, gala gecesi ve ödül töreniyle sona erdi.

Organizasyona Acacia Maden İşletmeleri, Çayeli Bakır İşletmeleri, Defaş Madencilik, Esan Eczacıbaşı, Eti Bakır, Eti Krom, Gübretaş Maden Yatırımları, Gümüştaş Madencilik, Öksüt Madencilik, Tümad Madencilik, Tüprag Madencilik, Türk Altın İşletmeleri ve Zenit Madencilik’in arama kurtarma ekipleri katıldı. Takımlar; yeraltı, yangın, deprem, kimyasala müdahale, araç kazası ve takım yetkinliği olmak üzere altı kategoride yarıştı.

Dört gün boyunca “iş güvenliği” mesajlarının verildiği organizasyonda şirketlerin yanı sıra kamu kurumlarından temsilciler de yer aldı. Açılış konuşmacıları arasında Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği Genel Müdürlüğü Daire Başkanı Mehmet Eren Sökmen, Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakan Yardımcısı Abdullah Tancan ve Rize Valisi İhsan Selim Baydaş bulunurken Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanlığı bürokratları da organizasyona katıldı.

Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakan Yardımcısı Tancan, açılış konuşmasında iş sağlığı ve güvenliği ile çevreyi madencilik sektörünün “asla esnetilmeyecek” iki kırmızı çizgisi olarak tanımladı. Kürsüden verilen bu mesajlara karşın yarışmaya katılan şirketlerin iş güvenliği sicili dikkat çekti.

BirGün’den İlayda Sorku’nun haberine göre yarışmanın ev sahibi Çayeli Bakır İşletmeleri daha önce bir iş cinayetiyle gündeme geldi. Şirket henüz First Quantum Minerals bünyesindeyken 3 Şubat 2017’de işçi Serdar Dede, maden sahasında bir iş makinesinin geri manevrası sırasında aracın altında kalarak yaşamını yitirdi. Çayeli Bakır İşletmeleri daha sonra Cengiz Holding tarafından satın alındı.

Cengiz Holding bünyesindeki bir diğer yarışmacı ise Eti Bakır oldu. 2012 yılında Samsun Eti Bakır tesisinde amonyak tankının kapağının düşmesi sonucu 7 işçi hayatını kaybetti, 12 işçi yaralandı. Olayın ardından “taksirle ölüme neden olmak” suçlamasıyla dava açıldı ancak 2015 yılına gelindiğinde davada tutuklu sanık kalmadı.

Tarım Kredi iştiraki Gübretaş’ın işlettiği Bilecik Söğüt’teki altın madeninde de bir işçi yaşamını yitirdi. 2022 yılında sahada çalışan taşeron işçi Sebahattin Duman’a geri manevra yapan greyder çarptı. Ağır yaralanan Duman hayatını kaybetti. Gübretaş Maden Yatırımları da Rize’de arama kurtarma ekibiyle yarışan 13 şirket arasında yer aldı.

Yarışmaya katılan şirketlerden biri de Defaş Madencilik’ti. Bağımsız Maden İş, 2024 yılında AKP’li Ferhat Nasıroğlu’nun şirketi Fernas ve Koç Holding’e bağlı Demir Export ortaklığındaki Defaş Madencilik’in Soma’da işlettiği maden sahasında Galip Uçar isimli işçinin yaşamını yitirdiğini açıkladı. 27 yaşındaki işçinin ölümü haberlere “özel bir maden işletmesinde yer altında çalışırken hayatını kaybettiği” şeklinde yansıdı. Olayla ilgili soruşturma başlatıldı.

Yıldırım Holding bünyesindeki Eti Krom’un sahasında yaşanan iş cinayetinin üzerinden ise henüz üç ay bile geçmedi. 29 Haziran 2026’da Elazığ’ın Alacakaya ilçesindeki Eti Krom sahasında taşeron Denson Madencilik bünyesinde çalışan Murat Demiroğlu, geri manevra yapan kepçe ile duvar arasında kaldı. Demiroğlu hayatını kaybederken olayla ilgili soruşturma başlatıldı.

Yarışmacılar arasındaki en yakın tarihli iş cinayetlerinden biri Nurol Holding bünyesindeki Tümad Madencilik’in sahasında meydana geldi. Eylül 2026’da Balıkesir’in İvrindi ilçesindeki Tümad maden sahasında ekskavatör taşıyan tır kontrolden çıkarak yaklaşık 20 metrelik …

author: Frey Blake-Pijogge, Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: In a changing northern landscape, Inuit bear guards keep people safe in the wilderness
content:
A nanuk (polar bear) in Tongait KakKasuangita SilakKijapvinga (Torngat Mountains National Park) in northern ‘Labrador.’

Photo by Frey Blake-Pijogge


After retiring from his career as a federal conservation officer, Derrick Pottle — an Inuk Elder from Tikigâksuagusik (Rigolet) — devoted himself to guiding people on the land, carving, hunting, and training bear guards.


The seasoned instructor and guide founded BearSafe Planning in 2005, which trains and certifies students to perform the role of guarding for all bear species found in the region —  including polar bears, grizzly bears, and black bears. 


Pottle’s three-day course is advertised as offering “safety, protection, confidence in bear country.” Bear guards work to monitor for bears  and prevent encounters with humans out on the land.


“The whole objective of the course,” he told IndigiNews, is firstly “people’s safety” around bears. But that aim “is followed very closely” by “bear safety,” he explained.


“We want to prepare people … to recognize some of the potential signs that the bear is not comfortable,” he continued. “They may feel threatened, they may feel intimidated, and they may even charge or attack you.”


He teaches his students “how to recognize those signs, how to prepare yourself for them, the tools you have to use to do your job.”


Inuk Elder Derrick Pottle is founder of BearSafe Planning in Rigolet, Nunatsiavut.

Photo by Frey Blake-Pijogge


‘More and more bears’ year-round


Pottle developed BearSafe Planning’s training program with input from groups that included Parks Canada, conservationists, Inuit Elders, and academics.


It initially started “out of a necessity,” Pottle said, after the creation of

Tongait KakKasuangita SilakKijapvinga

 (Torngat Mountains National Park) in northern “Labrador,” part of the 2005 Labrador Inuit Land Claims Agreement.


“They needed bear guards there … We didn’t have trainers in Nunatsiavut at the time,” he recalled. “Somebody had to do it.”


As climate change impacts landscapes across the North, he said the need for trained bear guards is only growing for “all species of bears.”


“We’re seeing more and more bears now in this time of our lives than we ever saw before,” he said.


“People are seeing polar bears in this part of Inuit Nunangat — where polar bears used to travel north late in the spring — and now are staying all summer long.”


He added that, among the many changes Inuit are seeing in their environment because of climate change, animals are also adapting their behaviour.


Tikigâksuagusik (Rigolet) is a community of more than 325 residents in the Nunatsiavut region of northern ‘Labrador.’

Photo by Frey Blake-Pijogge


“They’re showing up in places where we’ve never seen them before,” he said.


The province’s Endangered Species Act

lists

 polar bears as “vulnerable,” while the federal government deems them a “species of special concern.” 


An estimated 60 to 80 per cent of the world’s polar bear

population

 lives in “Canada,” according to Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC). 


Weighing up to

650 kilograms

, the massive carnivores are “reliant on sea ice to travel, mate, and hunt,” the department’s website states.


“Climate change is the main threat to polar bears,” ECCC states, “because it results in sea ice loss, which leads to fewer opportunities to hunt its preferred prey of seals.”


Sherri Wolfrey, a certified bear guard and secretary of Northern Lights Academy in Rigolet.

Photos courtesy Sherri Wolfrey


‘What to expect … if you came upon a bear’


The role of a bear guard can offer employment opportunities, but also can be used for personal safety, Pottle explained. 


“Lots of people just use the bear guard course for their own personal protection when they’re out on the land with their families fishing, hunting and participating in Inuit lifestyle.”


Sherri Wolfrey, a mother of four, is a trained bear guard in Rigolet as well. 


Wolfrey recounted how, in 2015, she became “interested in the program and just thought ‘Okay, maybe someday I might want to try for a job that involves bear monitoring.’”


Wolfrey is the secretary of Northern Lights Academy in Rigolet, and said she uses her training when she’s out on the land. 


“Especially up in that area in the bottom of the Mealy’s, it was so beautiful up there,” she told IndigiNews.
